integration.name: Twilio WhatsApp
integration.tagline: WhatsApp on the Twilio account you already have
integration.summary: If you already send SMS through Twilio, this is the same account with a WhatsApp-enabled number. The credential fields are literally the same two, so there is nothing new to look up.

credentials.label: Account SID
credentials.note: The same Account SID as your Twilio SMS connection.

credentials.label: Auth Token
credentials.note: The same Auth Token — Twilio does not issue a separate one per channel.

config.label: Sender number (From)
config.note: A Twilio number with WhatsApp enabled. It must belong to the same account as the credentials above.

strengths: The same credentials as the SMS connection you may already have
One account, one invoice, two channels
A familiar console and error vocabulary if you already run Twilio
considerations: The sender number has to be enabled for WhatsApp in your Twilio console before the connection can send.
Our default pacing starts at 1 message/second, matching the SMS connection. Twilio rate-limits per sending number, so raise it once you know your quota.
